description.value: Maison d'la Poutine House is a Quebec-inspired restaurant in Chilliwack offering classic poutine alongside handmade-dough pizzas with toppings like Montreal smoked meat and pepperoni. The menu leans into hearty, comfort-food staples that make for a satisfying refuel after a long day in the saddle. Orders can be placed online for pickup or delivery.
